name: dice_bluff_2round
description: Two-round dice bluff: ante 1, fair 3-sided private die each, betting round (bet 1), then a loaded 3-sided private die each (1/2, 1/3, 1/6), betting round (bet 2), higher dice total wins. Chance at depths 0, 1 and mid-game.
